businesses.business: industrial steam management, electric thermal solutions and peristaltic pumps

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures steam system products, electric process heating equipment, and peristaltic pumps and fluid path technologies. Sells to industrial, pharmaceutical, food and beverage and other process customers, mainly through direct sales engineers and some distributors, with related engineering services.

primary_products.value: steam traps; control valves; boilers and heat exchangers; electric process heaters and temperature sensors; peristaltic pumps and single-use fluid path assemblies

primary_services.value: steam system engineering and energy-efficiency consulting; installation and commissioning; maintenance and repair; boiler house and steam audit services

customer_segment.value: B2B: process manufacturers, pharmaceutical and biotech firms, food and beverage producers, hospitals, chemical and power companies

end_markets.value: food and beverage; pharmaceuticals and biotechnology; chemicals; healthcare; power generation; general manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: steam, electric heating and pump equipment and consumables, including recurring single-use components; service fees: engineering, installation, maintenance and energy-efficiency services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes steam, thermal and pump equipment from purchased materials and components, sold to industrial and life sciences users and equipment makers; service provider: provides steam engineering, installation and maintenance support to industrial customers

geography_served.value: global: Operates in over 40 countries across Europe, Americas, and Asia-Pacific, with a UK headquarters

specialization.value: related lines: steam thermal energy solutions, electric thermal solutions and peristaltic pumps/fluid path technologies serving process industries

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales engineers serving industrial end users and OEMs; distributors / dealers: independent distributors in smaller markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: pressure equipment, safety and environmental rules, pharmaceutical quality standards such as FDA GMP for biopharma customers

notes: Details on channel mix and exact segment structure are from general knowledge and may be slightly outdated.
